comments.body:
Can the `creditsToSend === 0` case actually happen in practice? 
I can think of when user selects a list with 0 subscribers but this guarded by the incompleteSteps check (entry `"To"` inside the `incompleteSteps` array)

Personal preference is to have the initial default to `isLoading: true` because it makes writing tests easier, and can simplify some data-is-ready checks later on. 
Happy with either way. Up to you.
super minor feel free to ignore nit: Perhaps `hasRecipients`?
